verdict.rationale: Code-owner approval rules are a fair governance question for a Git forge like Gitea, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents generic pull-request code review and user permission/ACL management. Nothing mentions CODEOWNERS files, path-based ownership, or required approvals from designated owners, so these are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an open-source-maintainer, I can require approval from designated code owners for changes to the paths they own
